UserAccountBackup.title: UserAccountBackup
UserAccountBackup.description: Cloud backup of a verified user's football trivia profile, favorite club, unique username key, and progression state.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

usernameKey.description: Normalized unique username key reserved in /usernames.

email.description: Verified email address from Firebase Auth.

avatar.description: Equipped emoji or Star PP avatar identifier.

progressionJson.description: Serialized JSON snapshot of UserProgression (coins, points, unlocked store items, quests, friends).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest sync.

UserHandleReservation.title: UserHandleReservation
UserHandleReservation.description: Global unique username reservation record containing no PII.

usernameKey.description: Canonical lowercase normalized handle matching document ID.

displayName.description: Exact formatted player name shown in-game.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID that owns this handle.

PublicPlayerProfile.title: PublicPlayerProfile
PublicPlayerProfile.description: Publicly inspectable non-PII football trivia profile, cosmetics, and match/career performance statistics (excludes email, recoveryCode, and wallet coins).

usernameKey.description: Normalized unique username key matching document ID.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

avatar.description: Equipped avatar emoji or Star PP identifier.

hasCrown.description: Whether the player unlocked the Legend crown.

statsJson.description: JSON snapshot of public match and minigame performance stats.

lastActivityId.description: Unique identifier of the player's latest public activity event.

lastActivityType.description: Category of the latest friend-visible activity event.

lastActivityTitle.description: Short summary label for the latest activity event.

lastActivityCode.description: Optional tournament join code associated with the activity event.

lastActivityScore.description: Optional score value achieved in the latest high score activity.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest public profile update.

/users/{userId}.description: Private cloud save document owned strictly by the authenticated and email-verified user.

/usernames/{usernameKey}.description: Publicly readable (by exact key lookup only, list denied) global username uniqueness lock.

/publicProfiles/{usernameKey}.description: Publicly readable (by exact key lookup only, list denied) non-PII player profile and performance stats document.
